name: Hamza
self_text: Hi, I'm Hamza! I'm a Japanese woman in my early 20s who loves woodworking for the creativity. I mainly play Skyforge Arena on console, usually queuing for casual matches in a support role. I am happy to coach. I'm free Sunday morning, Sunday afternoon, or Saturday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I need you to be the one who gets coached by me and you have to be flexible about your role. I'd strongly prefer that you are available Saturday afternoon, Sunday afternoon, or Sunday morning, though it's not a requirement. It would matter a lot if you are into casual matches, but I won't rule you out over it. Ideally, you are into Skyforge Arena or Tidewatch, but no big deal.
